A LITTLE ORIENTATION

Your plan, in perspective.

Shape the roadmap

Click the project title to rename it. Choose Add workstream beside the drawing tools, type a name and press Enter to create a lane. Double-click a workstream name to edit its name, description and color; use its separate chevron to collapse it. A collapsed workstream keeps one summary bar with its initiative count and activity periods. Click the summary bar to expand it again. Choose a project palette color or a custom workstream color. Roadmap shows the overview; Gantt gives each initiative a row for detailed scheduling. Open Filters to narrow the workstream, status or outcome. Turn off Show increments there to hide delivery bars while keeping milestones and their assignments. Your display choice is remembered on this device. Choose a drawing tool and click or drag on the canvas to create an initiative, milestone or increment. Click an item to edit its name in place. Double-click it for compact details. Drag an initiative up or down to reorder Gantt rows or move between workstreams. A straight vertical drag keeps its dates. Drag left or right to reschedule; drag either edge to resize. Board cards move between status columns. Use compact details to edit dates, owner and other fields. Turn on Freeze beside the year controls to keep filters, drawing tools and date headings visible while you scroll.

Keep delivery connected

Drag a connector circle to another item to create a dependency. You can also tap the two connector circles. Select an arrow to reconnect or remove it. Circular links are prevented. Dates never cascade automatically. Increments group a named delivery window, and milestones mark a checkpoint. Choose Milestone, then click an increment bar to place a checkpoint on it. Drag the milestone vertically to another increment; a straight vertical move keeps its date. Double-click the milestone to choose its shape and color from the visible icons and swatches, or toggle its date line. Nearby milestones stay on the same line; crowded labels shorten to fit. Hover or edit a label to read its full name. Use Colors in the top bar to compare the recommended palettes in miniature roadmap previews, choose from More palettes, or edit either custom palette. The selected palette applies across Roadmap, Gantt, Board, Table, Outcomes and Milestones. The OKLCH generator lets you set the Number of colors from 6 to 24, adjust hue, lightness and chroma, and apply the result to Custom 1 or Custom 2. Every generated color can be assigned to a workstream, increment or milestone.

Measure what matters

Outcomes track the result you want to achieve. Choose View roadmap on an outcome to see its initiatives and target together. Double-click an initiative and expand Purpose & priority to describe the problem, link an outcome or change its priority. Outcome progress measures the metric, independently of how many initiatives have shipped.

Take your plan with you

Changes are saved in this browser. Export a JSON backup to move your plan between devices, download an HTML app containing your current plan, or export just the Roadmap, Gantt or Board as a PDF. Detail registers are optional. This is a personal workspace; it does not sync between devices.

On a phone, swipe across the roadmap or board. Tap a workstream name for its details. Tap an item to edit its name; double-tap for compact details.
